name: Art Bundle
description: Render-only art extras: empire liveries with a withered look (tint band, emblem decal and hull number on the original ships; paint fades, grime, rust and pitting grow with age since the last retrofit or long repair) and livelier battle damage (embers in fresh hits, scorch around them). The base-game damage overlay is always on. Nothing here changes the simulation.

flags.name: liveries
flags.label: Empire liveries
flags.description: Tint band, emblem decal and hull number over the original ship art, withering with age; pirates start withered.

flags.name: damageFx
flags.label: Damage embers and scorch
flags.description: Ember glow in the newest damage clusters for a few seconds and a scorch halo around each cluster (off = the original's damage look).
